info.name: ipx IP Lookup API
info.description: Geolocation, network, time zone, locale and security data for any IPv4 or IPv6 address. IP data by DB-IP (https://db-ip.com, CC BY 4.0) and IPinfo (https://ipinfo.io, CC BY-SA 4.0).

item.name: Look up the caller's IP address

request.description: Returns the lookup result for the IP address the request comes from. Responses are marked `Cache-Control: no-store` because they depend on the caller.

query.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `ip,location.country,security`. A group name (`location`) returns the whole group; `success` is always included.
Language for continent and country names: en (default), de, es, fr, ja, pt-BR, ru, zh-CN, fa, ko. Unknown values fall back to English. City and region names are English only.
JSONP callback name (letters, digits, `_`, `$`, `.`). The response becomes `callback({...});` and is always sent with HTTP 200, errors included.

request.description: Returns geolocation, network, time zone, locale and security data for one IPv4 or IPv6 address. Private and reserved addresses return HTTP 200 with `reserved: true`.

query.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `ip,location.country,security`. A group name (`location`) returns the whole group; `success` is always included.
Language for continent and country names: en (default), de, es, fr, ja, pt-BR, ru, zh-CN, fa, ko. Unknown values fall back to English. City and region names are English only.
JSONP callback name (letters, digits, `_`, `$`, `.`). The response becomes `callback({...});` and is always sent with HTTP 200, errors included.

variable.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up.

item.name: Look up up to 100 IP addresses

request.description: Needs an API key. Each address counts as one lookup against the monthly quota. Invalid addresses do not fail the request; they get an item with `success: false`.

query.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `ip,location.country,security`. A group name (`location`) returns the whole group; `success` is always included.
Language for continent and country names: en (default), de, es, fr, ja, pt-BR, ru, zh-CN, fa, ko. Unknown values fall back to English. City and region names are English only.

request.description: HTTP 200 when both IP databases are loaded, 503 (`status: "degraded"`) otherwise. Includes the build date and age of each database and list.
